info.tvl: The value deposited in every observed pool whose two tokens have a known price, at the end of the last complete hour. Its change compares with its level at the start of the chosen period.
info.volume: What was traded over the chosen period, valued at each trade's own price, up to the last complete hour. The change compares with the previous period of the same length.
info.fees: What those trades paid in fees over the chosen period: the depositors' (LP) share and the protocol's.
info.pools: The pools with at least one trade over the chosen period, among every pool Yog-Scope has seen, and those born during the period.

protocols.title: Activity by protocol · {period}
protocols.info: A protocol is a program that runs trading pools. Yog-Scope observes one today; the others will come one by one.
protocols.tableLabel: Activity by protocol over the chosen period

signals.title: Signals
signals.info: Unusual behaviour spotted automatically in the observed pools. These are findings, not advice.
signals.empty: No signal yet — the detectors are watching.

volume.infoHourly: What was traded, hour by hour, over the chosen period.
volume.infoDaily: What was traded, by 24-hour slices ending at the last complete hour, over the chosen period.

tokens.title: Most traded tokens · {period}
tokens.info: The tokens that moved the most over the chosen period, all protocols together: a trade counts for both its tokens. A volume followed by a fraction covers only those pool-hours, the others could not be valued.

page.title: Signals
page.description: Live feed of the detectors' conclusions: flow imbalances, price deviations — every anomaly worth a look, as it is detected.

feed.title: Latest signals
feed.empty: No signal yet — the detectors are watching.

price_oracle_deviation.summary: The pool's price is {deviation} away from the oracle price.
price_oracle_deviation.explain: Compares the pool's spot price (derived from its on-chain state) with the two tokens' oracle price (Jupiter). A relative gap beyond the threshold flags a price detached from the market — possible arbitrage or abnormal liquidity. The threshold shown on each signal is the one that was crossed (warning or critical).

flow_imbalance.summary: Swap volume leans {percent} in one direction.
flow_imbalance.explain: Measures the directional imbalance of swap volume over a rolling window: (A→B volume − B→A volume) / total volume, from −100% to +100%. A flow leaning hard one way flags sustained buy or sell pressure. A volume floor filters out near-idle pools.

tvl_drain.summary: {percent} of the pool's liquidity has left.
tvl_drain.explain: Measures, over a rolling window, the share of the pool's starting TVL that has been withdrawn: (removals − adds) / starting TVL. A high drain flags an LP exodus or rug-like behaviour. Withdrawals offset by deposits (rebalancing) cancel out; a TVL floor filters out dust pools, and a pool whose tokens cannot be priced is skipped rather than misread.
